legacy_version: V1 is an auditable prototype, not an accepted final model. Its report, frozen sources and evaluations remain unchanged.
validation_limit: Scenarios 121–180 have been evaluated and inspected. Subsequent development must not claim a fresh blind final test. New work is exploratory modelling and scenario-level internal validation on 1–120.

priority.existing_evidence: Economic units can be derived; the three numerical preferences have not been identified from questionnaire information.
priority.next_check: Compare explicit drawdown preferences with risk-constraint-first formulation. Explain horizon scaling and average drawdown versus tail suitability.
priority.acceptance: A stated economic trade-off and consistent use of horizon; do not select a preference merely to maximize backtest returns.

priority.existing_evidence: Disclosed assumptions with limited alpha sensitivity; not established from withdrawal or customer-preference data.
priority.next_check: Separate questionnaire loss amount from exceedance probability. Study interval, exceedance severity and assignment stability under training resampling.
priority.acceptance: No client-specific exceptions chosen to force desired labels; uncertain boundary cases are explicit.

priority.existing_evidence: Joint resampling preserves asset-inflation relationships within blocks. Dependence length and decision convergence have not been validated.
priority.next_check: Audit numerical Monte Carlo variation before selecting simulation size. Then examine development-only temporal structure and block lengths.
priority.acceptance: Simulation error must be small relative to the action margin; numerical convergence does not certify forecast validity.

priority.item: 0.002 action margin, asset floor and target restrictions
priority.existing_evidence: Implemented and tested, with no evidence yet that these particular settings are necessary or stable.
priority.next_check: Separate forecast uncertainty from a conservatism preference; compare continuous/grid sensitivity and bounded-update ablations only after base objectives are settled.
priority.acceptance: Decisions should not depend materially on one arbitrary seed or one grid point.

priority.existing_evidence: Mechanically executable; no demonstrated real service capacity, response time or guaranteed loss mitigation.
priority.next_check: Distinguish financial risk breach, model failure and input failure. State realistic pending alternatives without inventing adviser returns.
priority.acceptance: Explain why human review is required and why waiting behaviour is appropriate; do not equate a pause with risk elimination.

work_order: Agree on mathematical objective, risk definitions and parameter meanings.
Check base portfolio and forecast numerical/stochastic stability.
Predeclare scenario-level nested internal validation and limited candidates.
Evaluate customer suitability and cost-gated execution with uncertainty.
Evaluate incremental target updates and governance rules.
Write or revise the submission report after model review and development evidence.

internal_validation_draft.status: design proposal, not executed or approved as final protocol
internal_validation_draft.caveat: Overlapping training folds and reused scenarios do not create new independent data or certify a 10% tail probability.
